title: Drought priming modulates ABF, GRFs, related microRNAs and induce metabolic adjustment during heat stress in chickpea.
authors: Juneja, Sumandeep; Saini, Rashmi; Mukit, Abdul; Kumar, Sanjeev
one_liner_zh: 该文研究鹰嘴豆干旱预激后热胁迫下ABF/GRF转录因子及miRNA表达与代谢调整，仅含ABF3-GRF14蛋白-蛋白对接，缺乏TF-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: Drought and high temperature stress may occur concomitantly or individually in succession causing cellular dysfunctions. Abscisic acid (ABA) is a key stress regulator, and its responsive genes are controlled by ABRE (Abscisic acid Responsive Element)-binding factors (ABFs)and G-Box Regulatory factors (GRFs). Here, we identify ABFs, GRFs and targeting miRNAs in desi and kabuli chickpea. To validate their role after drought priming and subsequent high temperature stress, two contrasting chickpea varieties (PBG1 and PBG5) were primed and exposed to 32  degrees C, 35  degrees C and 38  degrees C for 12, 6 and 2 h respectively and analyzed for Physio-biochemical, expression of ABFs, GRFs and MiRNAs, and GC-MS based metabolite analysis. To ascertain the ABF-GRF protein-protein interactions, docking studies were carried out between the ABF3 and GRF14. Genome-wide analysis identified total 9 & 11 ABFs, and 11 GRFsin desi and kabuli respectively. Their gene structure, and motif composition were conserved in all subfamilies and only 10 and 12 genes have undergone duplication in both desi and kabuli chickpea respectively. These genes were differentially expressed in-silico. MiR172 and miR396 were identified to target ABFs and GRFs respectively. Protein-protein interaction (ABF3 and GRF14) might be successful only when the ABF3 was phosphorylated. Drought priming downregulated miR172 and miR396 and eventually upregulated targeting ABFs, and GRFs. Metabolite profiling (GC-MS) revealed the accumulation of 87 metabolites in Primed (P) and Non-Primed (NP) Chickpea plants. Tolerant cultivar (PBG5) responded better in all respects however both severity of stress and exposure are important factors and can produce broadly similar cellular response.
abstract_zh: 干旱和高温胁迫可能同时发生或相继单独发生，导致细胞功能紊乱。脱落酸（ABA）是关键的胁迫调节因子，其响应基因受ABRE（脱落酸响应元件）结合因子（ABFs）和G-Box调节因子（GRFs）控制。在此，我们在desi和kabuli鹰嘴豆中鉴定了ABFs、GRFs及其靶向miRNAs。为验证它们在干旱预适应及随后高温胁迫中的作用，选用两个对比鲜明的鹰嘴豆品种（PBG1和PBG5），分别预适应后暴露于32°C、35°C和38°C，持续12、6和2小时，并分析其生理生化特性、ABFs、GRFs和miRNAs的表达，以及基于GC-MS的代谢物分析。为确定ABF-GRF蛋白-蛋白相互作用，对ABF3和GRF14进行了对接研究。全基因组分析分别在desi和kabuli鹰嘴豆中鉴定出共9个和11个ABFs，以及11个GRFs。其基因结构和基序组成在所有亚家族中均保守，且desi和kabuli鹰嘴豆中分别仅有10个和12个基因经历了复制。这些基因在计算机模拟中差异表达。miR172和miR396分别被鉴定为靶向ABFs和GRFs。蛋白-蛋白相互作用（ABF3和GRF14）可能仅在ABF3磷酸化时成功。干旱预适应下调了miR172和miR396，并最终上调了靶向的ABFs和GRFs。代谢物谱分析（GC-MS）显示，在预适应（P）和非预适应（NP）鹰嘴豆植株中积累了87种代谢物。耐性品种（PBG5）在所有方面响应更佳，但胁迫严重程度和暴露时间均为重要因素，并可能产生大致相似的细胞响应。
